methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Bubble Robotics is a private robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jean Crosetti and Patricia Apostol. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private firms—including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics—and one public company (277810.KQ), all operating within the Robotics & Manufacturing sector.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this analysis. The sector contains ten same-sector comparables, but none satisfy the narrow filtering criteria required for meaningful peer benchmarking: zero companies share the target's stage, zero occupy adjacent stages, and zero fall within similar valuation tiers. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias and obscure stage-specific and tier-specific dynamics. Consequently, no quantitative valuation range can be derived from the available dataset without violating analytical rigor.

The current dataset does not provide sufficient depth to support a triangulated valuation. To advance this analysis, additional data would be required: either identification of same-stage or adjacent-stage robotics peers with disclosed valuations, or disclosure of Bubble Robotics' own stage classification, recent funding round size, or revenue metrics. The scarcity of narrow comparables reflects the fragmented nature of private robotics funding and the heterogeneity of business models within the sector.
